# Changelog

## Unreleased

- Fixed `src.money.round_money` to use banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`) per FIN-212 (was incorrectly using `ROUND_HALF_UP`).

args.message:
Fix money rounding to use ROUND_HALF_EVEN per FIN-212

round_money was using ROUND_HALF_UP while the docstring and FIN-212
spec require banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN), causing
tests/test_money.py to fail in the nightly build.

- Switch quantize rounding to ROUND_HALF_EVEN
- Add changelog note

args.body:
## Summary
The nightly build failed because `src/money.py` rounded money with `ROUND_HALF_UP` while the docstring and the FIN-212 spec (and `tests/test_money.py`) require banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`).

This PR switches `round_money` to use `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` so that half-cent values round to the nearest even cent (e.g. `2.675 -> 2.68`, `2.665 -> 2.66`).

## Changes
- `src/money.py`: changed `quantize` rounding from `ROUND_HALF_UP` to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` to match the documented behavior per FIN-212.
- `CHANGELOG.md`: added an unreleased changelog note.

## Testing
- Triggered CI on this branch; run `ci-0001` on commit `6f401f8e98` **passed** (including `tests/test_money.py`, which now passes on both half-cent cases).

Refs: FIN-212
